# XingAI

Primary URL: https://xingai.app

XingAI builds focused AI decision systems for everyday life and research.
It is not a generic chatbot. Each product is built around one decision
and a clear next action.

Flagship public surface: the Invest AI Industry Map
https://invest.xingai.app/ai-map

The map is a cache-rendered research view of AI supply-chain layers and
cited public filings. It is not a broker, allocation board, or trade signal.

Product catalog: https://xingai.app/apps

Languages: English, Chinese, Korean.

Live or demo products:
- Invest AI (Industry Map): https://invest.xingai.app/ai-map
- Cook AI: https://cook.xingai.app
- Travel AI: https://travel.xingai.app
- Meal Coach: https://meal.xingai.app
- Wear AI: https://wear.xingai.app
- SAT AI: https://sat.xingai.app
- Research AI: https://research.xingai.app
- Learn AI: https://learn.xingai.app
- Routine AI: https://routine.xingai.app
- Decision Agent: https://decision.xingai.app
- Performance Sim: https://lab.xingai.app
- Daily Assistant: https://daily.xingai.app
- T Today (invite-only early access): https://t.xingai.app

Decision Agent:
- Product page: https://xingai.app/apps/decision-agent
- Official app: https://decision.xingai.app
- Purpose: turn an investment outcome into a structured brief projected
  from Invest AI’s public AI-map worker cache, then stop at human confirmation.
- Boundary: informational only. No invented allocations, broker connection,
  or autonomous trading.

Coming-soon and internal ops tools (Growth Monitor, Ops Status, Eval Registry)
are listed on the catalog for the team. They are not the public flagship.

Legal:
- https://xingai.app/legal/privacy
- https://xingai.app/legal/terms
- https://xingai.app/legal/disclaimer

Outputs are informational. Verify before you book, cook, study, or invest.
